findings.summary: The historical-wrapper identity declaration is the sole authorization for accepting a superseded wrapper digest, yet it is git-ignored (.gitignore:53 '/validation/*/'), untracked, not tracked-checked by the auditor, and not hash-pinned in the closure manifest unlike every other evidence class. Its current_canonical_wrapper digest is format-checked but never cross-hashed against the live file, so a stale or tampered declaration is undetectable. Any actor with working-tree write (archive extraction, dropped file) can declare new identities without modifying any pinned artifact.
findings.fix: Commit the declaration (exempt it from the ignore rule), require tracked-at-HEAD in _load_historical_identities, pin its sha256 in the closure manifest, and cross-hash current_canonical_wrapper against Simulator/wksim_core/model.cpp.

findings.area: git tracked check bypass via index
findings.summary: _is_tracked uses 'git ls-files --error-unmatch', which is satisfied by any staged-but-never-committed index entry. The declared durability claim (archived_repo_path_tracked: true, 'durable') is therefore not enforced: an attacker can 'git add' a replacement archived copy without any commit. Today's real instance is sound (verified at HEAD, commit 4e161e2, byte-identical), but the check does not prove it.
findings.fix: Replace with 'git cat-file -e HEAD:<path>' plus blob-digest equality (git rev-parse HEAD:<path>), or 'git diff --quiet HEAD -- <path>' after ls-files.

findings.summary: _wsl_precheck_found decodes only the leading JSON value and ignores the remainder. A tracked rflysim-named file carrying a valid empty receipt plus arbitrary trailing text (base64-encoded DLL, vendor config, scripts) is classified as a clean 'nothing found' receipt. Only NUL bytes and a non-receipt leading document are caught.
findings.fix: Bound trailing content: after raw_decode accept only whitespace, or lines matching the documented 'wsl: ' warning form; anything else is an offender. Prefer storing receipts as pure single-document JSON.

findings.summary: On Windows the cold_library, cold-probe and build-output byte re-hashes are skipped as host_bounded, yet status is ready_blocked_by_formal_dependency and exit is 0. On Linux the same /root products are missing and the audit fails closed (N3 mechanism verified), so no host can currently produce a fully verified pass; the only passing configuration is the skipping one. No should-fail path is swallowed (POSIX paths are genuinely unaddressable on Windows), but exit 0 does not distinguish 'all checks passed' from 'three declared-evidence checks skipped'.
findings.fix: Main acceptance should require an empty host_bounded list, or the tool should emit a distinct status/exit code when host_bounded is non-empty.

findings.summary: _load_historical_identities reads the declaration without the _secure_file symlink/reparse-point guard applied to every other evidence file. Impact is low (content is strictly JSON-validated and the archived path is re-secured), but the asymmetry is unjustified.
findings.fix: Route the declaration through _secure_file before reading.

findings.summary: _vendor_offenders inspects only tracked names containing 'rflysim' or ending .dll/.zip. Vendor binaries with other extensions (.so, .exe) and no rflysim substring are not content-classified. Scope appears intentional (vendor-runtime-named material), recorded for completeness.

defenses_confirmed: N1: malformed/duplicate-key declaration is a violation and exit 2 (fail-closed)
N2: found as string/0/{}/[null]/non-empty list is classified as vendor material
N3: addressable-but-missing provenance path is a violation, never host_bounded
missing declaration yields empty identity map; wrapper pinned to current source (fail-closed)
archived copy missing/drifted/untracked all fail (three fixture tests)
POSIX-absolute provenance is never mapped onto the current drive on Windows
traversal/backslash/empty segments rejected in archived_repo_path via _repo_relative
duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers rejected by the strict loader
CLI exit 0 iff status ready_blocked_by_formal_dependency, 2 otherwise (test_cli_exit_codes)
decision: NOT approved for main acceptance: P1-1, P1-2 and P1-3 must be fixed or explicitly adjudicated first. No P0 found; the frozen-original binding itself (digest, size, HEAD tracking) is verified sound in the real repository.
